Create, modify, and inspect a graph and its property maps

graph.Rd

Create and modify a native graph-tool adjacency structure, inspect its vertices and edges, attach numeric edge property maps, and transform edge weights with exact change-of-variables log-Jacobians.

Usage

graph_create(n = 0L, directed = TRUE)
graph_add_vertices(graph, n = 1L)
graph_add_edges(graph, edges, properties = NULL)
graph_num_vertices(graph)
graph_num_edges(graph)
graph_edges(graph)
graph_degree(graph, mode = c("total", "in", "out"))
graph_set_edge_property(graph, name, values)
graph_edge_property(graph, name)
graph_edge_properties(graph)
graph_set_vertex_property(graph, name, values)
graph_vertex_property(graph, name)
graph_vertex_properties(graph)
graph_set_graph_property(graph, name, value)
graph_graph_property(graph, name)
graph_graph_properties(graph)
# S3 method for class 'rgraphtool_graph'
print(x, max_edges = 20L, max_ascii = 12L,
  ascii = NULL, ...)
transform_weights(x, transform = c("identity", "log", "log1p", "sqrt",
  "sign", "abs", "rank", "zscore"), shift = 0)

Arguments

n

Non-negative number of vertices.

directed

Whether the graph is directed.

graph

A graph created by graph_create().

edges

Two-column numeric matrix of 1-based source and target vertex IDs.

properties

Optional named list or data frame of edge vectors (each of length nrow(edges)) to attach as edge property maps aligned with the newly added edges.

mode

Degree type. Undirected graphs support only total degree.

name

Non-empty character string naming a graph, vertex, or edge property map.

values

Vector, matrix, or list of property values aligned with graph_edges(graph) (for edge properties) or 1:graph_num_vertices(graph) (for vertex properties).

value

Single value (scalar, vector, or raw object) for a graph-level property.

x

For print(), an rgraphtool_graph object; for transform_weights(), a finite numeric vector of edge weights to transform.

max_edges

Maximum number of edges to display in the edge preview.

max_ascii

Maximum vertex count for automatically displaying the ASCII adjacency matrix.

ascii

Optional logical overriding whether to display the ASCII adjacency matrix.

...

Unused; included for S3 print compatibility.

transform

Weight transformation to apply. Invertible continuous transformations ("identity", "log", "log1p", "sqrt", "zscore") attach the exact log-Jacobian \(\sum_e \ln |f'(x_e)|\) as attribute "log_jacobian" for change-of-variables model comparison.

shift

Optional finite numeric constant added to x before applying transform.

Details

Graphs are mutable and aliases share the same underlying graph. External pointers cannot be restored from R serialization. Parallel edges and self-loops are allowed; a self-loop contributes two to total degree. Edge endpoints are returned in their original orientation even for undirected graphs.

Edge properties passed through graph_add_edges(properties = ...) are stored by internal edge insertion index and returned by graph_edge_property() in the exact row order of graph_edges(graph), even when edges are inserted out of vertex order.

Value

graph_create() returns a graph. Modification functions invisibly return the graph. Counts return numbers, graph_edges() returns a two-column integer matrix, graph_degree() and graph_edge_property() return numeric vectors, graph_edge_properties() returns a character vector of property names, and transform_weights() returns a numeric vector with attributes "transform" and "log_jacobian".

Examples

g <- graph_create(3)
graph_add_edges(g, rbind(c(1, 2), c(2, 3)),
                properties = list(weight = c(1.5, 4.2)))
graph_degree(g, "out")
#> [1] 1 1 0
w <- graph_edge_property(g, "weight")
transform_weights(w, "log")
#> [1] 0.4054651 1.4350845
#> attr(,"transform")
#> [1] "log"
#> attr(,"log_jacobian")
#> [1] -1.84055
